title: Analista de manutenção III
description: Estamos com oportunidade para ANALISTA DE MANUTENÇÃO III (JUNIOR). Para atuação em contrato efetivo modelo presencial (Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro). A SICPA tem a vocação para desenvolver parcerias na exploração de soluções tecnológicas, especialmente na implantação de sistemas de rastreamento com marcação segura. Baseada em tintas de segurança visíveis e invisíveis, a utilização pode ocorrer no controle de produção industrial, da garantia de autenticidade, origem de produtos agrícolas, confiabilidade de medicamentos, marcação de combustível, entre outros. Temos orgulho de oferecer soluções tecnológicas integradas, inovadoras, confiáveis e inteligentes para o mercado de rastreamento seguro. Nosso negócio está alicerçado em parcerias sólidas e estratégicas com empresas líderes em seus diversos segmentos, a partir do desenvolvimento de alternativas sob medida, que protegem a sociedade de fraudes e falsificaçoes. Acreditamos que a inclusão fortalece nossa equipe e enriquece nossas soluções, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho mais diversificado e inclusivo. Sendo assim, todas as nossas vagas são extensivas a pessoas com deficiência ( PcD). MISSÃO DO CARGO: Prestar suporte nas atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva das instalações e equipamentos, garantindo a continuidade operacional e a segurança das operações. Auxiliar na análise de chamados, controle de documentos técnicos e acompanhamento de serviços terceirizados, assegurando conformidade com normas e procedimentos internos. Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, sugerindo melhorias para otimização dos processos de manutenção. Trabalhar em equipe com os analistas pleno e sênior, adquirindo conhecimento técnico e operacional para o desenvolvimento contínuo. Contribuir para a eficiência e organização das rotinas de manutenção, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Superior completo ou cursando na área de Engenharia ou correlatas. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES (10 mais relevantes): Apoiar a gestão da manutenção preventiva e corretiva: Auxiliar no planejamento e execução das manutenções em equipamentos e instalações, garantindo o cumprimento do cronograma e minimizando impactos operacionais Acompanhar e registrar ordens de serviço: Controlar e atualizar registros de manutenção em sistemas internos, garantindo rastreabilidade e suporte para auditorias e análises futuras Dar suporte no controle de contratos de prestadores de serviços: Auxiliar na gestão de contratos de empresas terceirizadas, monitorando prazos, qualidade dos serviços e conformidade com os acordos estabelecidos Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações: Apoiar a equipe na identificação de possíveis falhas e necessidades de manutenção, garantindo a conservação dos ambientes e o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos Monitorar estoques de materiais e peças de reposição: Auxiliar no controle dos insumos necessários para manutenção, garantindo disponibilidade e evitando atras os nos serviços programados; Apoiar a análise de relatórios e indicadores de manutenção: Coletar e organizar dados sobre manutenções realizadas, ajudando na análise de eficiência dos processos e na implementação de melhorias; Interagir com fornecedores e equipes internas: Prestar suporte na comunicação com fornecedores e demais áreas da empresa, garantindo o alinhamento de demandas e soluções adequadas; Auxiliar na implementação de melhorias nos processos de manutenção: Identificar oportunidades para otimização de processos, contribuindo com sugestões baseadas em boas práticas e no acompanhamento diário das operações; Garantir a conformidade com normas de segurança e meio ambiente: Apoiar na implementação de medidas de segurança do trabalho e sustentabilidade nas atividades de manutenção, garantindo atendimento às regulamentações; Desenvolver conhecimento técnico para evolução na área: Trabalhar em conjunto com os analistas pleno e sênior, adquirindo experiência e aprimorando habilidades para crescimento profissional dentro do setor. Assistência Médica (extensivo a dependentes legais); Assistência Odontológica (extensivo a dependentes legais); #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Descrição da vaga Se você quer trabalhar com propósito e fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Responsabilizar-se pelo processo de coleta de materiais biológicos dos pacientes, através da separação das amostras, gerando reserva de soro, garantindo a qualidade e disponibilidade de material biológico para os exames. Registrar as informações relacionadas às suas atividades em sistemas específicos, garantindo a rastreabilidade das informações de atendimento. Registrar as informações relacionadas às suas atividades em sistemas específicos, garantindo a rastreabilidade das informações de atendimento. Organizar e suprir o setor, através de sistemas, impressos e rotinas específicas, garantindo a continuidade do trabalho, de acordo com o direcionamento da gestão imediata. Após a coleta, transportar o material biológico coletado, até ao Laboratório, assegurado a identificação correta e integridade das amostras. Receber e encaminhar ao Laboratório material oriundo de outros setores, para realização das análises, conforme os fluxos estabelecidos e garantindo o acondicionamento adequado durante o transporte. Venha fazer parte da maior rede de saúde da américa latina! Somos líderes em saúde na América Latina, com hospitais, clínicas oncológicas e serviços presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil. Somos feitos de pessoas que acreditam no cuidado, na excelência e no impacto positivo que a saúde pode gerar na vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias. Aqui, tecnologia, inovação e humanização caminham juntas. Investimos continuamente no desenvolvimento das nossas equipes, em pesquisa, ensino e em novas formas de transformar a experiência de pacientes, acompanhantes e profissionais. Na Rede D'Or, acreditamos na força de times que compartilham conhecimento e atuam com propósito, transformando o cuidado em saúde. title: BOMBEIRO HIDRAULICO

Apoiar em atividades diversas, conforme orientação e necessidade da área. Auxiliar no desenvolvimento do Ajudante. Desenvolver produção de kits hidráulicos e aplicação. Zelar pela segurança da obra e colaboradores, qualidade dos serviços conforme procedimentos da empresa e meio ambiente de acordo com as leis, normas e procedimentos. title: Líder de Logística
description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos. Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento. Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio . Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento. Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável. title: Sr. Project Finance Analyst
description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment, excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision-making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations and executive-ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. description: Position Summary The Change Order Manager will lead change order budget creation activities between project management, functional leads, and the financial analysts in order to develop, explain, and provide variance analysis for the change orders in preparation for presentation to the client. Strong Excel/Microsoft Office skills and ability to thrive in a multi-tasking environment. Strong financial skills combined with an attention and appreciation to detail. High energy and enthusiasm with a strong commitment to exceeding expectations. Flexibility and willingness to work on multiple assignments of varying tasks with personnel throughout the organization. Ability to learn quickly. Good oral and written communication & interpersonal skills with the ability to connect and build relationships with management and others throughout the organization. Exhibits self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment. Team player with a desire to be an active, long-term participant in the growth of the company. VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE! Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil. Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de 3.000 colaboradores e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe. Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada. Os Centros de Emergência Regional (CER) são um modelo de atendimento de urgência e emergência clínica que compõem uma rede organizada de atenção ao carioca. Elas funcionam 24 horas e são instaladas sempre ao lado de um grande hospital de emergência, absorvendo o atendimento dos casos de menor complexidade. Dar assistência técnica aos usuários do laboratório; Proceder à realização de exames laboratoriais sob supervisão; Realizar experiências e testes em laboratório, executando o controle de qualidade e caracterização do material; Separar soros, plasmas, glóbulos, plaquetas e outros; Preparar os equipamentos e aparelhos do laboratório para utilização; Controlar e acompanhar a utilização de materiais, instrumentos e equipamentos do laboratório; Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza, assepsia e conservação de equipamentos e utensílios do laboratório em conformidade com as normas de qualidade, de Biossegurança e controle do meio-ambiente; Auxiliar na confecção de relatórios técnicos e estatísticos; Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado; Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas informatizados; Utilizar os equipamentos de proteção individual; Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM; Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD. Técnico de Laboratório Completo Experiência de 06 (seis) meses na função de Técnico de Laboratório. A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Exercer a liderança técnica de dois profissionais, orientando prioridades, distribuindo demandas, revisando entregas e apoiando o desenvolvimento da equipe. Desdobrar a estratégia de Segurança Cibernética OT em roadmap, projetos, padrões técnicos, planos de ação e indicadores. title: Dressing and Signage Design Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES To manage the design and artwork of all printed and digital materials required for the Dressing and Signage and function. To manage the creation of any mock-ups or visualisations that are required for the Dressing and Signage Function. To manage a network of in-house freelance designers and the workload for appointed supplier based design teams. To work with suppliers to create templates for all artworks, with all production considerations catered for such as required bleed etc. To work with other functional areas to create template visualisations of spaces across official sites. To be the initial and primary member of the artwork sign of team ensuring all artworks meet the design guidelines and principles for the respective competitions. Develop and manage a robust design and artworking process with the Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers, maximizing use of their content management systems where possible. Acting as the focal point for all Dressing and Signage design and artwork related queries and inputting into team meetings and reporting where necessary. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. title: Product Operations Specialist | Fraud Operations Processes
description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI‑powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting‑edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross‑border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper‑growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top‑tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high‑performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Product Operations Specialist focused on Fraud Operations Processes, you will not just execute risk policies—you will be the architect of how our fraud operations scale. In a hyper‑growth fintech environment moving millions of dollars over WhatsApp, efficiency, speed, and accuracy are paramount. Your mission is to own, audit, and optimize our entire Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) library, bridging the gap between risk management, product capability, and operational execution. You will map out, fix and scale complex workflows, identify automation opportunities alongside Engineering and Product, and package high‑volume processes so they are ready to be seamlessly executed and ready to stop fraud while ensuring the legitimate user experience. Your ultimate goal is to build bulletproof, invisible guardrails that mitigate fraud while ensuring a frictionless user journey for legitimate customers recovering from false declines. Responsibilities SOP Architecture & Process Scalability: Maintain, continuously improve, and own the single source of truth for all live fraud operational processes. Standardize and document high‑volume workflows into clear, repeatable, step‑by‑step processes that can be executed consistently by any team member with minimal ramp‑up or oversight. Governance & Audit Cadence: Design and execute internal monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and spot‑checks for core processes to ensure compliance, maintain high quality, and significantly improve user journey. Process Metrics & KPIs: Define, track, and optimize key health metrics for fraud workflows, including process adherence, operational throughput, and process quality. Automation & Tooling Improvement: Identify systemic operational bottlenecks, build data‑driven business cases for automation, and partner directly with Product Ops and Engineering to implement tools that eliminate manual overhead. Change Control & Strategic Alignment: Own versioning, sign‑off, and cross‑functional communication whenever a process evolves. Partner closely with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality and Training to ensure updates are instantly reflected in capacity models and training calibrations. User Experience Safeguarding: Ensure that while minimizing fraud risk, the user recovery journey is seamless, minimizing friction when legitimate users face false declines. Requirements Fraud/Payments Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of financial fraud risk vectors and known patterns. SOP & Process Engineering: Proven track record of mapping, documenting, and scaling complex operational workflows within high‑growth fintechs or tech environments. Automation & Outsourcing Mindset: Experience prepping operational processes for automation or external vendors, with a sharp eye for separating high‑judgment tasks from transactional ones. Data Fluency: Strong hands‑on experience querying data (SQL, BigQuery, Omni, or similar) to extract process metrics, build operational dashboards, and back up business cases with hard numbers. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to align cross‑functional teams including Customer Operations, WFM, Product, Quality Assurance, and multiple stakeholders. Autonomy under Ambiguity: A true "owner" mentality with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating and creating structure out of unstructured startup environments. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency and advanced communication skills in English. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. What We Offer Competitive salary Initial stock options grant Annual performance bonus Health, dental, and vision plans Continuous learning opportunities Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment Equal Opportunity Employer At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination. description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role The Global Lending Foundations team, within our Global Lending BU, is building the platform that fundamentally changes how we design, build, and roll out lending decisions across new geographies. Our mission is to create the tools and evolve the architecture that make it dramatically easier to launch lending products in new countries, with high business impact and direct exposure to Nu’s global expansion. As a Staff Software Engineer – Lending Foundations , you will be a senior technical leader in this platform layer: defining the long-horizon technical direction for how Lending platforms scale across countries, products, and partners, and shaping how every future lending product is built across Brazil, the US, Mexico, Colombia and future markets. You will operate at platform scale — building shared infrastructure that other teams depend on for years — while working in a highly engaged, multi-level engineering group (IC7–IC4) and partnering closely with product and business leaders. You’ll be responsible for Owning the architectural vision for Lending Foundations: Define and evolve the platform architecture that underpins lending products across countries, products, and partners, making decisions that outlast individual cycles. description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi‑year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Lead organization‑wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API‑level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per‑authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must‑have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi‑year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice‑to‑have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role We are looking for an engineer who has already built with AI in production. You have shipped LLM-powered systems (agents, copilots, RAG pipelines, or AI-driven automations), you know what breaks when they meet real users, and you know how to make them reliable enough for business-critical workflows. Your day-to-day is applied AI engineering: designing agentic workflows, integrating LLMs into internal tools and business processes, building evaluation and guardrail layers, and turning manual, high-friction workflows into AI-assisted ones that thousands of Nubankers depend on. This is not an infrastructure role. You will not spend your days on Terraform, IAM policies, or email deliverability. Cloud fluency helps, but the core of this job is the AI layer - prompts, context, agents, evaluations, integrations - and the product judgment to know where AI genuinely helps versus where deterministic automation is the right answer. Key Responsibilities Applied AI & Agentic Systems Design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that automate complex internal processes end-to-end. Work hands-on with frontier models and the modern AI stack: tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, RAG, multi-agent orchestration. Own the full lifecycle of an AI system: from problem discovery and prototype to production hardening, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluation & Reliability Build evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and quality feedback loops so AI systems can be trusted in production - not just demoed. Define what "good" looks like for non-deterministic systems and instrument it: evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review where it matters. Intelligent Workflow Automation Use orchestration platforms (e.g., n8n) and custom integrations as delivery vehicles for AI-in-the-loop automation across business units. Integrate enterprise platforms (Slack, Google Workspace, Jira, internal APIs) into coherent, AI-assisted workflows. AI Adoption & Governance Drive the technical strategy for AI adoption within engineering and business workflows. Develop governance frameworks that make AI coding assistants and agents safe, compliant, and effective - balancing developer freedom with security and operational risk. Multiplier Work Create Golden Paths, reference implementations, and documentation that let other teams build AI workflows safely on their own. For Lead/IC6: act as the technical reference for applied AI in the domain, influence architecture beyond the immediate team, mentor senior engineers, and partner with ITSec and Privacy to align AI solutions with company policy. For Senior/IC5: execute complex AI projects with high autonomy, identify workflow bottlenecks worth automating, and mentor mid-level engineers. What are we looking for? Must Have - Demonstrated Applied AI Experience Shipped LLM systems in production: at least one real system with an LLM at its core - an agent, copilot, RAG application, or AI-driven automation - used by real users, not a proof of concept. Hands-on AI engineering: practical fluency with prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent frameworks or orchestration patterns. Evaluation mindset: experience measuring and improving AI output quality - evals, test sets, feedback loops - and an honest understanding of failure modes (hallucination, drift, prompt injection). Solid software engineering foundation: proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or Clojure; strong API and integration skills; the discipline to ship maintainable systems, not notebooks. AI product sense: the judgment to identify which problems deserve an LLM, which need deterministic automation, and which should not be automated at all. Nice to Have Experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, or custom orchestration engines). Exposure to cloud services (AWS) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with AI developer tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and AI governance practices. Behavioral & Strategic Skills Builder bias: you prototype fast, validate with real users, and harden what works. Governance-aware: you understand that "efficiency" must be balanced with "security", and you can design AI systems that are safe by default without destroying velocity. Multiplier: you enjoy documenting your work, creating Golden Paths, and teaching others how to use what you build. Comfortable with ambiguity: AI capabilities shift monthly; you treat that as an opportunity to re-solve problems better, not as churn. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow. As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale. You’ll be responsible for Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations. Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle. Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling. Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect. Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products. Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations. Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI‑assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI‑first security engineering looks like. Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team. Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security‑by‑design reviews. Hands‑on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off‑the‑shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine). Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert‑level depth not required, but real familiarity is). Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them. Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Fluency with AI‑assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically. Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture. Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem‑solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non‑technical audiences. Nice to have Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts. Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols. Experience integrating with third‑party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar). Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context. Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional. Somos reconhecidos pela inovação e pela força de nosso time multidisciplinar , formado por profissionais que lideram suas áreas de atuação e têm seu talento reconhecido nos maiores rankings do Brasil e do mundo. Temos em nosso DNA o compromisso com a responsabilidade social . Participamos de projetos de inserção e capacitação de jovens no mercado de trabalho, temos um sólido Programa de Diversidade & Inclusão e criamos iniciativas que fortalecem promovem um ambiente inclusivo e criativo . Atuamos de forma abrangente em diferentes áreas do Direito, com destaque para nossa liderança em Propriedade Intelectual. Também oferecemos suporte especializado em Contencioso, Relações de Consumo, Contratos, Direito e Tecnologia, Direito da Publicidade, Regulatório, Compliance e Investigações Internas, além de Avaliação de Ativos Intelectuais . Além de nossa reconhecida atuação em Propriedade Intelectual — abrangendo marcas, patentes, direitos autorais, desenhos industriais e segredos de negócio — oferecemos suporte jurídico qualificado em diversas áreas do Direito, como Contencioso Cível e Empresarial, Mediação e Arbitragem, Relações de Consumo, Contratos, Direito e Tecnologia, Direito Regulatório, Compliance e Investigações Internas, Avaliação de Ativos Intelectuais entre outras. Somos mais de 180 profissionais especializados , com formações que vão do Direito à Engenharia, passando por áreas como Química e Farmacêutica . Estamos em constante atualização para acompanhar as transformações e as demandas do mercado, oferecendo soluções completas e inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Se você busca aprendizado, crescimento e a chance de atuar em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Main responsibilities Atuação em processos de recuperação crédito Bancário, desde a petição inicial até o encerramento; Elaboração de peças processuais, pareceres e relatórios jurídicos; Interface com clientes e partes envolvidas. Boa comunicação oral e escrita; Organização, atenção aos detalhes e facilidade para trabalhar com documentos, sistemas e controles . Additional information Necessário experiencia na área em demandas de contencioso de massa - Relações de Consumo cliente Banco do Brasil. title: Project Analyst - Oil and Gas
description: About dss+ At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects - you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future. We are a purpose-led global consultancy partnering with organisations in high-risk and asset-intensive industries to solve complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability. We combine deep expertise, practical problem-solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for our clients. Why This Role This is an opportunity to support high-impact projects within the Oil & Gas sector, working alongside experienced consulting teams and senior client stakeholders. You will play a critical role in project governance, performance tracking, and decision support, helping ensure successful execution of complex transformation and operational improvement initiatives. This role offers excellent exposure to strategic programs while developing core consulting, project management, and analytical capabilities. Oil & Gas – Why This Industry The Oil, Gas & Energy sector is undergoing significant transformation as it balances growing global demand with the transition to lower-carbon energy systems. At dss+, we help clients improve safety, optimise performance, and accelerate their sustainability and energy transition strategies. This is a key industry where we support organisations to navigate complexity and deliver long-term, sustainable impact. Your Impact at dss+ You will support the successful delivery of consulting engagements by helping project teams manage governance, track performance, monitor risks, and ensure alignment against strategic objectives. Working closely with project leaders and client stakeholders, you will provide data-driven insights, maintain project controls, and develop executive‑level materials that support effective decision‑making. Key Accountabilities Support project governance activities, ensuring effective control of schedules, risks, actions, and deliverables Consolidate and monitor project KPIs, developing reports and performance dashboards Perform data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement Develop high‑quality executive presentations and management reports for clients and project leadership Support project planning, tracking, and control activities across multiple workstreams Organize project meetings, document key decisions, and monitor follow‑up actions Maintain project documentation and ensure adherence to governance processes Contribute to the preparation of client deliverables and project status communications Promote discipline in project execution, ensuring deadlines, commitments, and deliverables are effectively managed Support continuous improvement initiatives, including the use of digital and AI‑enabled solutions What You’ll Experience at dss+ Deliver on our Purpose Be part of a values‑led organisation where your work helps save lives, improve performance, and advance sustainability for our clients and their people. Develop your Trusted Expertise Gain early autonomy and real accountability, working closely with senior clients on complex, high‑impact challenges. Thrive in a Culture of Respect Join an inclusive and collaborative environment where your voice is valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported. Shape your Career Accelerate your development through hands‑on experience, structured learning, and opportunities to work on international projects. Who You Are You bring strong analytical thinking, a structured mindset, and the ability to work effectively in complex and fast‑paced environments. You are comfortable working with data, managing multiple priorities, and supporting stakeholders through clear communication and high‑quality deliverables. Experience Experience supporting projects, PMO activities, business analysis, or consulting engagements Experience developing reports, dashboards, and management presentations Exposure to project planning, governance, performance monitoring, or operational improvement initiatives Experience within consulting, industrial, energy, or asset‑intensive environments is advantageous Capabilities Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy Strong communication and stakeholder engagement capability Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Results‑oriented approach with a commitment to excellence in execution Technical Skills Advanced Excel, including data analysis, dashboards, and pivot tables Advanced PowerPoint with experience preparing executive‑level presentations Knowledge of project planning, governance, and project controls Experience with Power BI, MS Project, or similar project management and reporting tools is desirable Familiarity with AI‑enabled solutions and productivity tools is advantageous Education & Languages Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Postgraduate qualification or certification in Project Management or Finance is advantageous Fluency in English required Mobility Willingness to travel as required Growth & Benefits We invest in your development and success through: Structured learning and development, including our Consulting Development Academy Mentorship from experienced leaders and industry experts Opportunities to contribute to international projects Competitive salary, performance‑based incentives, and comprehensive benefits Flexible working policies A Bit More About Us We are implementers and change‑makers. Our teams work from the boardroom to the shop floor, helping organisations build resilience, improve performance, and sustain results over time. Our expertise spans industries including metals and mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and private equity — combining deep operational knowledge with transformation and capability‑building expertise. Diversity & Inclusion dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued, and able to contribute fully. We believe diversity strengthens our organisation and drives better outcomes for our people, our clients, and the communities we serve. #LI-RS2 #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: AR Game Designer — Mobile & WebAR - LATAM
description: About The Project We are developing an augmented reality entertainment experience that transforms physical family-friendly, Horror-themed tombstones into interactive monster encounters. About The Project We are developing an augmented reality entertainment experience that transforms physical family-friendly, Horror-themed tombstones into interactive monster encounters. The product combines physical retail merchandise with two levels of digital experience: Phase One — WebAR: A frictionless 10–15 second cinematic experience triggered by scanning a QR code. The monster appears to emerge directly from the physical tombstone. Phase Two — Mobile Game: A native iOS and Android experience where players confront monsters in their own environment using a supernatural “Van Helsing-inspired” weapon system, capture them, and return them to their graves. We are looking for an AR Game Designer to own the gameplay design and help turn the creative concept into simple, compelling, highly repeatable interactions. What You’ll Do Define the core gameplay loop for short-form AR monster encounters. Design intuitive mechanics that work naturally with a smartphone camera and physical tombstone. Develop the interaction between the player, monster, environment, and virtual weapon. Design a supernatural weapon mechanic capable of firing plasma or fantastical energy, weakening/capturing monsters, and dragging them back into their graves. Determine how each monster (3) behaves during encounters and where character-specific mechanics add meaningful value. Design encounters that are immediately understandable and satisfying within approximately 15–30 seconds while supporting longer play sessions. Establish progression, scoring, replayability, difficulty, rewards, and player feedback systems. Explore how leaderboard and competitive mechanics can extend engagement. Help determine whether multiplayer/social gameplay belongs in the initial product or future roadmap. Design onboarding that requires minimal instruction and gets users into the experience quickly. Work closely with AR engineers to design around real-world tracking, mobile hardware, performance, safety, and environmental constraints. Collaborate with animation, VFX, audio, character art, and engineering so gameplay mechanics feel integrated rather than layered onto the experience. Prototype, playtest, evaluate, and rapidly iterate mechanics based on client and user feedback. Help establish systems that can expand beyond Halloween into additional characters, seasonal variants, collectibles, and future experiences. What We’re Looking For Professional experience as a Game Designer, AR Game Designer, Systems Designer, or Gameplay Designer. Experience designing mobile, AR, VR/XR, location-based, or other interactive real-time experiences. Strong understanding of short-form gameplay loops and immediate player feedback. Ability to translate a broad creative idea into clearly defined mechanics, rules, states, and interactions. Strong understanding of player motivation, progression, reward, difficulty, and replayability. Experience designing gameplay around physical movement, camera-based interaction, or spatial environments. Ability to communicate mechanics clearly through design documentation, diagrams, prototypes, and direct collaboration with developers. Comfortable working in a fast-moving prototype environment where gameplay is continuously tested and refined. A portfolio of work is mandatory. Nice to Have Hands-on Unity experience. Experience with AR Foundation, ARKit, ARCore, 8th Wall, or comparable AR platforms. Experience designing combat, capture, projectile, aiming, or physics-based mechanics. Experience with physical products, toys-to-life, location-based entertainment, or connected collectibles. Familiarity with multiplayer and leaderboard systems. Experience designing family-friendly horror entertainment. The Design Challenge The gameplay should be family friendly and simple enough to understand immediately but satisfying enough that players want to do it again. This is not intended to become a complicated combat game. The “magic” comes from seeing a physical object come alive, confronting the creature in your own environment, and having an interaction that feels responsive, theatrical, and fun. The physical tombstone, AR character, weapon, VFX, animation, spatial audio, and gameplay should feel like one experience and not separate features. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Essa é uma oportunidade para o nosso time de Núcleo de Atendimento , com foco no atendimento e relacionamento com os clientes, prestando suporte e buscando oferecer uma experiência cada vez melhor em nossos canais de atendimento. Se você gosta de atender pessoas, tem boa comunicação e acredita ter o perfil para a oportunidade, estamos doidos para te conhecer! Main responsibilities Realizar atendimento aos condôminos por meio dos canais de comunicação da empresa (telefone, whatsapp, e-mail e presencial), prestando suporte em demandas como esclarecimento de dúvidas, emissão de segunda via de boletos, envio de atas e demais solicitações. Buscar soluções para as solicitações apresentadas pelos clientes, garantindo agilidade e qualidade no atendimento. Contribuir para a satisfação dos clientes, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas e acompanhamento das demandas. Monitorar os resultados das pesquisas de satisfação e atuar como representante da voz do cliente dentro da organização, compartilhando oportunidades de melhoria identificadas. Acompanhar e/ou prestar suporte aos Gerentes de Condomínio em assembleias, quando solicitado. Providenciar o envio de editais para gráficas, Correios e distribuição física aos condomínios. Atualizar títulos vencidos e emitir segunda via de boletos para pagamento. Emitir segunda via de recibos aos condôminos, orientando-os quanto aos canais de autoatendimento disponíveis. Emitir boletos para reserva de áreas e espaços comuns dos condomínios. Realizar a cobertura do horário de almoço da recepção, conforme escala definida. Conduzir o atendimento e acompanhamento de solicitações de acordos financeiros realizadas pelos clientes em todos os canais de atendimento. Acompanhar metas e indicadores da área, contribuindo para o alcance dos resultados estabelecidos. Cumprir e zelar pelo cumprimento das políticas, normas, processos e diretrizes organizacionais da empresa. Requirements and skills Requisitos: Ensino Médio completo; Conhecimento do Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel, Word e PowerPoint; Experiência com atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente no segmento condominial. Competências desejáveis: Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Organização e atenção aos detalhes; Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe; Capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal; Proatividade e foco na resolução de problemas; Orientação para a satisfação do cliente. Additional information Oferecemos: Remuneração Fixa: R$1.887,87 Horário: Seg a Sex, de 8h às 17h30 Ticket Flex de R$ 33,00 por dia útil; Vale-Transporte por dia presencial; Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica; TotalPass e Wellhub (através do Plano de Saúde); Mais 1,5 salário atrelado resultados individuais e participação nos lucros; Home Office - Híbrido (presença no escritório 2 vezes por semana); Auxílio home office Verba para cursos e universidade corporativa; Descontos em instituições de ensino, serviços de saúde e restaurantes parceiros; Day off de aniversário (um dia de folga no mês de aniversário); E um ambiente e cultura super agradáveis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Cumim
description: O Grupo Arpoador busca Cumim para nos ajudar a encantar nossos clientes com nosso atendimento leve e cordial, sendo a conexão perfeita entre nosso menu e a experiência à beira-mar que oferecemos. Valorizamos os princípios da ética, elegância natural, sustentabilidade, excelência, gentileza e união em todos os aspectos do nosso negócio. Se você compartilha desses valores e gosta de lidar com o público, candidate-se! Analisaremos o seu currículo com prazer. Requisitos Experiência com atendimento ao cliente; Boas habilidades de comunicação; Cordialidade. Responsabilidades Auxílio ao atendimento ao cliente: Receber os clientes, levar utensílios e auxiliar na montagem das mesas. Preparação da estação de trabalho: Colaborar na arrumação das mesas, incluindo talheres, guardanapos, copos e pratos, e manter a estação de trabalho limpa e organizada. Limpeza e organização: Realizar tarefas de limpeza, como limpar mesas e cadeiras, e manter o ambiente do restaurante limpo e organizado. Servir alimentos e bebidas: Auxiliar na entrega de pratos e bebidas aos clientes. Apoio à cozinha: Auxiliar na comunicação entre os clientes e a cozinha, garantindo que os pedidos sejam transmitidos corretamente e que os pratos sejam servidos no momento adequado. Cumprimento de normas de higiene: Seguir as diretrizes de higiene e segurança alimentar para manter um ambiente saudável e seguro. Colaboração em equipe: Trabalhar em conjunto com garçons, chefs e outros membros da equipe para proporcionar um serviço eficaz e de alta qualidade. Apoio aos clientes: Atender às solicitações dos clientes, como fornecer mais utensílios ou bebidas, quando necessário. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ENFERMEIRO(A) - HOME CARE
description: Job description A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa. Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente. O que nos move: Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível; Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade; Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde. Como fazemos isso: Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência; Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários; Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito. Estamos à procura de um(a) Enfermeiro comprometido(a) em oferecer suporte de qualidade aos beneficiários, acompanhando de perto as demandas de saúde e promovendo um atendimento humanizado e eficiente. Main responsibilities Avaliar criteriosamente relatórios médicos e perfis assistenciais para a captação e admissão de pacientes, unindo a visão de saúde humanizada à viabilidade técnica e financeira; Elaborar, revisar e dimensionar o Plano de Atenção Domiciliar (PAD), ajustando com precisão a carga horária de enfermagem, insumos, medicamentos e equipamentos ao real nível de complexidade do paciente; Gerenciar com eficiência os recursos assistenciais: controlar cotas de materiais, dietas enterais/parenterais e equipamentos (oxigenoterapia, bombas de infusão, etc.), evitando desperdícios e garantindo o suprimento contínuo sem comprometer a qualidade do cuidado; Aplicar e monitorar escalas de elegibilidade e complexidade (ex.: ABEMID, NEAD) para reavaliar periodicamente o plano terapêutico e promover a desospitalização segura e progressiva (desmame/alta domiciliar); Acompanhar a evolução clínica dos pacientes com um olhar atento à prevenção de riscos (lesões por pressão, infecções, quedas) e identificação precoce de descompensações; Realizar a gestão e auditoria de prontuários de campo, alinhando a prática da equipe de ponta aos padrões de qualidade e ao uso racional dos recursos contratados; Dar suporte técnico e orientação à equipe e aos familiares/cuidadores, promovendo o engajamento e o cuidado focado na autonomia do paciente. Requirements and skills Graduação completa em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN; Pós-graduação ou especialização (concluída ou em andamento) em Atenção Domiciliar, Gestão em Saúde, Cuidados Paliativos, Saúde do Idoso ou Saúde da Família/Coletiva; Experiência anterior em Home Care, com conhecimento prático no equilíbrio entre a gestão assistencial e o controle de custos/recursos; Domínio na aplicação de escalas de complexidade assistencial (ABEMID, NEAD); Visão crítica para auditoria concorrente de prontuários e otimização de processos assistenciais; Pacote Office intermediário; Forte perfil comunicativo, empatia para entender a jornada do paciente/família e raciocínio analítico para solução de problemas operacionais. Additional information Vale Refeição: R$ 44,00 por dia (desconto simbólico de R$ 1,00 ao mês); Vale Transporte; Day Off no dia do aniversário; Plano de Saúde – sem desconto em folha; Plano Odontológico – sem desconto em folha; Total Pass – incentivo ao bem-estar e à atividade física; Descontos em instituições de ensino; Programa Leve Mente – voltado à saúde emocional; Parceria com Sesc - garante aos nossos colaboradores acesso exclusivo a uma rede completa de lazer, cultura, esportes e turismo, promovendo mais bem-estar e qualidade de vida; Horário de trabalho: segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Técnico de Campo II - Região de Volta Redonda (RJ)
description: Sobre a NCR Atleos A NCR Atleos, com sede em Atlanta, é líder na expansão do acesso financeiro. A NCR Atleos foi classificada em 12º lugar na prestigiada lista da Newsweek de 2025 dos 100 Locais de Trabalho Mais Amados do Mundo. Será necessário armazenar peças em casa, realizar recebimento e envio de materiais, além de manter o inventário atualizado. Executar serviços em produtos e soluções de baixa complexidade, com foco em produtos financeiros e ATMs (caixas eletrônicos). Realizar pequenos reparos e substituição de componentes em equipamentos Nível I, incluindo PCs, estações de trabalho, periféricos, impressoras e sistemas POS front-end. Atuar na manutenção de primeira linha de caixas eletrônicos e quiosques. Auxiliar na preparação do local, incluindo cabeamento, instalação de equipamentos, testes básicos e trocas modulares. Efetuar manutenções preventivas periódicas nos produtos sob sua responsabilidade. Diagnosticar falhas técnicas, realizar pequenos reparos e substituições em nível de módulo. Construir e manter relacionamentos positivos com clientes, assegurando comunicação clara e eficaz no nível local. Representar a NCR Atleos de maneira profissional, preservando a imagem e os valores da empresa. Seguir rigorosamente todos os procedimentos de segurança, especialmente ao atuar em ATMs e instituições financeiras. Qualificações Básicas Experiência prévia na área de informática com manutenção de hardware de PCs e suporte técnico, trabalhando com ATMs (caixas eletrônicos) ou na área de telecomunicações. Conhecimento dos sistemas operacionais Windows. Experiência com ferramentas básicas de manutenção e uso do Pacote Microsoft Office. Requisitos Obrigatórios Residir no estado de Ceará. Registro no CFT. CNH válida, categoria B ou superior. Comprovante de vacinação contra COVID-19 (2 vacinas). Disponibilidade para realizar viagens dentro do estado de Ceará. Disponibilidade para cumprir plantões definidos pela gestão, incluindo finais de semana e período noturno. Competências Comportamentais Proatividade e dinamismo. Responsabilidade e capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma. Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e cumprir prazos. Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas. Boa comunicação interpessoal e orientação ao cliente. Declaração de oportunidade de emprego igualitária A NCR Atleos é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais. É política do NCR Atleos contratar, treinar, promover e pagar associados com base em suas qualificações, habilidades e desempenho relacionados ao trabalho, independentemente de raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, status de cidadania, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade/expressão de gênero, gravidez, estado civil, idade, deficiência física ou mental, informações genéticas, condição médica, status militar ou veterano ou qualquer outro fator protegido por lei. Help us bring innovation to financial institutions across the globe. At NCR Atleos, you’ll have meaningful and relevant work experiences, with opportunities to learn and make a real contribution. We are dedicated to solving the challenges our customers face through continuous innovation and a commitment to setting the highest standard in self-service banking. A career at NCR Atleos means embracing our innovative culture and values, seeking new adventures and carving your own path. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Junior Data Management Analyst
description: Salary Range: R$48,000.00 To R$54,000.00 Annually Full Time Position, Monday - Friday The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers.KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers.Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities Launch your career in data management with Katalyst. As a Junior Data Management Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the intake, transfer, loading, quality control, cleanup, and delivery of geophysical and subsurface data for client projects. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will gain hands-on experience with seismic, non-seismic, and well data while developing a strong understanding of data governance standards, industry best practices, and Katalyst's proprietary tools and processes. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals who are detail-oriented, eager to learn, and interested in building technical expertise within the energy data management industry. The successful candidate will support both client site operations and internal project workflows, follow established procedures, communicate effectively with team members and clients, and contribute to the successful execution of data management projects while developing their professional and technical skills. Key Responsibilities: Support data management activities, including receipt, transfer, loading, validation, quality assurance, cleanup, organization, availability, and governance of files and data in accordance with established procedures. Monitor and organize data intake and output workflows through the Geophysical Data Network (RDG), client systems, and approved Katalyst tools. Perform operational procedures, complete checklists, conduct basic quality checks, and execute approved commands and scripts under appropriate guidance. Maintain accurate time tracking using corporate tools and support timely handling of billing-related information. Update control systems, spreadsheets, activity records, indicators, and operational documentation, including process notes, decision records, issue tracking, and status updates. Identify, record, and engage errors, inconsistencies, routine data issues, and technical concerns to the responsible analysts or project team members. Support data preparation, basic reporting, storage monitoring, disk usage review, workflow progress tracking, and data quality reporting as requested. Follow information security, confidentiality, and data governance standards when handling client, project, and company data. Communicate clearly and professionally with client personnel, Katalyst operational staff, and project team members to support effective project delivery. Qualifications & Skills: Working knowledge of data transfer concepts, file organization, and data loading processes, with a willingness to learn Katalyst and client-specific systems. Basic understanding of subsurface data types, including seismic, non-seismic, well data, related documents, and associated file formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented procedures accurately. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with basic proficiency in English. Ability to identify routine problems, document findings, cross-reference information, and escalation issues appropriately. Collaborative mindset with a strong team orientation and willingness to support shared project goals. Knowledge of key Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook. Basic knowledge of Linux commands used to browse, query, and copy files. Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language. Basic knowledge of file integrity checking and related quality control concepts. Strategic thinking and analytical capacity to review, compare, and connect information from multiple sources. Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain professionalism in a client-focused environment. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the Junior Data Management Analyst is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. This position may be performed remotely, at a Katalyst office, or on a client site. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening or weekend work required to support project or client needs. Required Education and Experience Undergraduate degree in data management, geoscience, information technology, databases, or a related field preferred. Minimum of two years of relevant experience in data management, geophysical or subsurface data support, data loading, data transfer, technical operations, or a related analytical environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia. Pronto pra entrar em campo com a gente? title: Assistente Social
