title: Integrity Engineer
description: Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Key Competencies Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands-on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications And Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA-RJ accreditation is required. Post-Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward-thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail-oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team-oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Operations Geologist / Petrophysicist
description: The Operations Geologist/Petrophysicist supports safe, efficient and environmentally responsible Geological operations, serving as the main liaison between the Subsurface and Drilling departments and as the focal point of communication with offshore Geological service providers. The role oversees the entire well construction process, from planning through post-mortem analysis, supporting key operational decisions (such as casing shoe depth selection and geosteering), preparing technical documentation, and ensuring compliance with established procedures and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Support safe, efficient and environmentally responsible Geological operations. Main liaison between the Subsurface and the Drilling departments. Focal point of communication between office and offshore Geological service providers (Wellsite Geologists, MWD/LWD, ML, WL), supporting decision-making as needed (e.g. casing shoe depth selection, geosteering). Support the complete well construction process, encompassing well planning, execution and post-mortem analyses, ensuring that the established procedures are met and well objectives are achieved in a cost-effective manner. Prepare documentation related to the well construction process (e.g. Drilling Program, Daily Reports, End-of-Well, Composite Logs). Plan formation evaluation data acquisition in exploration and development wells in coordination with the Drilling department and service providers. Manage temperature, pore pressure and Geomechanical data pre-spud, while drilling and post-mortem. Follow-up geological operations, attending regular and on-demand operational meetings. Quality assurance and quality control of wireline and logging while drilling logs. Formation evaluation and generation of composite logs, integrating log, core and dynamic data to provide inputs to static and dynamic models. Manage raw and interpreted formation evaluation logs, including maintaining databases. Support designing laboratory analysis . Ensure compliance with local regulations, including delivery of required documentation to regulator. Education Bachelor's degree in Geoscience. Master's degree is a plus. Experience & Qualifications Legally available to work in Brazil. Ability to write and communicate fluently in English and Portuguese . Strong background in oil and gas operations Proficiency in industry standard petrophysical software. Working knowledge of well operations. Flexibility/availability for occasional offshore work. Ability to work in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment. Offshore experience desired, experience in the Southeast Brazil basins a plus. Knowledge in Geomechanics a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agent Platform
description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We’ve also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. About the Role Commure is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own the platform powering our fleet of OpenClaw agents. Across Commure, we use autonomous agents to support teams, execute operational workflows, interact with internal systems, and turn organizational knowledge into action. As the number and capabilities of these agents grow, we need a strong technical foundation for deploying, operating, observing, and improving them safely at scale. You’ll own that foundation. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and applied AI. You’ll build the infrastructure that runs our agents, develop the harnesses that govern how they reason and act, and establish the tools engineers need to create and deploy new agents quickly. You’ll also operate the existing agent fleet and ensure it remains secure, reliable, observable, and cost‑efficient. We’re looking for a strong Python engineer with deep Linux fundamentals who can own both the agent software and the environments where it runs. The ideal candidate combines platform‑engineering rigor with practical experience building LLM‑powered agents and is comfortable moving between Python application code, Bash‑based operational work, Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands‑on role for someone equally comfortable working inside a Linux VM, debugging a Kubernetes workload, writing Python services and automation, designing an agent tool interface, investigating an LLM failure, and improving a deployment pipeline. What You’ll Do Own the infrastructure and runtime environment for Commure’s fleet of OpenClaw agents. Build, configure, deploy, and troubleshoot agents running across Linux‑based virtual machines. Develop Python services, automation, operational tooling, and agent integrations. Design, build, and operate agent harnesses that support tool use, memory, context management, permissions, scheduling, retries, and human escalation. Create a standardized platform for engineers to develop, test, deploy, and update agents safely. Deploy and operate agent workloads across Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud or AWS. Use Bash and standard Linux tooling to investigate system behavior, automate environment management, and resolve production issues. Build reliable systems for agent scheduling, background execution, queues, concurrency management, and long‑running tasks. Develop integrations that allow agents to interact with internal services, databases, APIs, communication platforms, and operational tools. Establish secure approaches to secrets, credentials, identity, permissions, and access control for autonomous agents. Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent reliability, task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost. Implement production observability across agent traces, prompts, tool calls, infrastructure, failures, and resource consumption. Create dashboards, alerting, and incident‑response processes for agent and platform health. Diagnose failures across application code, model behavior, third‑party tools, networks, containers, virtual machines, and cloud infrastructure. Improve the efficiency and resilience of the platform as agent usage and workload complexity grow. Work closely with product engineers and internal teams to convert promising agent prototypes into dependable production systems. Establish best practices for developing and operating autonomous agents across Commure. What You Have Professional experience building and operating production software, infrastructure, or internal platforms. Strong proficiency in Python, which will be the primary language for agent development, platform tooling, integrations, and automation. Excellent familiarity with Linux environments and hands‑on experience developing, deploying, and debugging software on virtual machines. Strong Bash and command‑line skills, including shell scripting, process management, networking diagnostics, filesystem operations, package management, and log investigation. Experience managing software across fleets of virtual machines, including configuration, deployment, monitoring, access management, and failure recovery. Strong hands‑on experience building and operating production systems on Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, including compute, networking, storage, identity and access management, and observability. Experience deploying and managing Linux virtual machines and containerized workloads in cloud environments. Hands‑on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized production workloads. Experience building infrastructure, deployment systems, internal developer platforms, or distributed application runtimes. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, secrets management, and automated deployments. Hands‑on experience building with large language models, autonomous agents, or agent harnesses. An understanding of agent concepts such as tool calling, memory, context management, planning, retries, evaluations, permissions, and human‑in‑the‑loop execution. Experience monitoring and debugging distributed systems using logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts. A strong understanding of production reliability, including failure recovery, idempotency, rate limiting, concurrency management, and incident response. The ability to balance fast experimentation with the security and reliability required for production systems. Strong ownership and communication skills, including comfort working across product, infrastructure, security, and operational teams. A builder mindset and excitement about creating infrastructure for a rapidly evolving category of software. Nice to Have You have built, extended, deployed, or operated an OpenClaw agent. You have contributed to OpenClaw or another open‑source agent framework. Experience operating a fleet of autonomous or long‑running AI agents. Experience building multi‑tenant agent platforms or internal developer platforms. Experience with agent evaluation, tracing, replay, simulation, or regression testing. Experience with browser agents, computer‑use agents, or agents that interact with external systems. Familiarity with model gateways, inference providers, prompt versioning, token accounting, and LLM cost optimization. Experience securing workloads that access sensitive data or high‑impact production tools. Familiarity with Swift and experience contributing to or supporting native Apple client applications. Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or another regulated industry. What Success Looks Like Within your first several months, you will: Develop a deep understanding of our existing OpenClaw agents, infrastructure, and operational workflows. Make the agent fleet easier to deploy, observe, debug, and maintain. Establish clear reliability and performance metrics for agents running in production. Reduce the time required to take an agent from prototype to production. Improve safeguards around credentials, permissions, tool execution, and sensitive data. Improve the reliability, repeatability, and security of our Linux VM and Kubernetes‑based agent environments. Create a platform that allows Commure teams to build increasingly capable agents without reinventing the underlying infrastructure. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Vessel Superintendent
description: What will you be doing? The Vessel Superintendent is accountable for the management and safe and efficient operation of assets and teams under their jurisdiction within an assigned fleet; including all permanent fixed equipment onboard (with support from specialist personnel as necessary). Vessel Superintendent must ensure that allocated assets are operated with maximised safety, to high quality, availability at optimised cost, and that all owned equipment is managed according to Company assurance policy. What will you be doing? The Vessel Superintendent is accountable for the management and safe and efficient operation of assets and teams under their jurisdiction within an assigned fleet; including all permanent fixed equipment onboard (with support from specialist personnel as necessary). Vessel Superintendent must ensure that allocated assets are operated with maximised safety, to high quality, availability at optimised cost, and that all owned equipment is managed according to Company assurance policy. Specific Key Responsibilities & Activities Develop and maintain reporting systems between vessel(s), onshore management and support teams. Actively demonstrate, promote and foster an exemplary Safety culture onboard assigned assets and, when required, support Regional HSSEQ initiatives. Promote and pursue Safety & Quality Predictable Performance across all aspects of work and team activities. Monitor assigned assets' performance against Company and F&E KPIs, challenge non-compliance and implement corrective action plans where required. Ensure timely and optimized execution of Safety and Pollution Prevention Critical Maintenance with minimal disruption to operations. Operate vessels efficiently within approved budget constraints. Develop and administer reliable budget forecasts against approved budget plans. Create and maintain accurate 5-year Vessel CAPEX plans. Implement Company policies and monitor execution and compliance with those policies and the Business Management System. Ensure vessel inventories, including spares and consumables, are effectively managed through critical spare assessments and within budget requirements. Manage and maintain accountability for Vessel Assurance Matrices (VAM) accuracy. Liaise with Project & Operations and other business functions to establish project requirements and provide support where possible. Coordinate with Technical & Engineering, Operational Support and Mobile Assets teams regarding equipment deliverables and assurance. Promote effective use of the Company Business Management System. Work closely with the DPA/CSO to ensure compliance with new legislation and regional regulatory requirements. Plan and execute major technical stops and dry docks in accordance with Company procedures, agreed milestones, budget and schedule, or liaise with the Drydock Project Manager when appointed. Manage vessel breakdowns and stakeholder notifications. Ensure implementation of ISM requirements. Liaise with Classification Societies, Flag States and Maritime Authorities to maintain vessel certification. Act as Line Manager for Captains and Chief Engineers of assigned vessel(s). Establish, monitor and conduct annual reviews of goals and objectives for assigned personnel. With support from the Crewing function, continuously maintain and adjust an adequate and cost-effective marine crew and team of technicians. Coordinate ISM audits, supported by the DPA/CSO, as well as LOLER, SUWER and Dropped Object compliance audits and surveys. Support the Sales & Marketing Department with bids and related activities. Knowledge & Qualifications Degree in Marine Engineering preferred; relevant experience may be considered. Master Mariner or Chief Engineer qualifications preferred; candidates with transferable skills from other ranks or positions will also be considered. Forward-thinking and able to anticipate vessel requirements. Strong maritime and managerial experience. Thorough knowledge of marine activities and vessel operating parameters. Proven ability to implement budget controls and achieve cost targets. Technical knowledge to support resolution of technical issues. Collaborative team player with strong decision-making, coordination, organization and stakeholder management skills. Ability to build consensus on complex issues and manage multiple priorities. Ability to manage interfaces between marine and project personnel. Proficiency in English. We value diversity and view differences as opportunities, ensuring conditions for the development of our professionals and society as a whole. All positions are open to persons with disabilities and individuals undergoing rehabilitation. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Auditor
description: Lead credibility where it matters most. Shape how the global mining and metals sector demonstrates responsible, ethical, and socially sound performance. Why This Role Matters As global scrutiny on mining and metals intensifies—from investors, communities, regulators, and Indigenous Peoples—credible, independent assurance has never been more critical. In this executive‑level technical role, you will sit at the intersection of social performance, human rights, and operational accountability , ensuring mining organizations meet internationally recognized standards while building trust with affected stakeholders. Your expertise will directly support responsible resource development and meaningful social outcomes across global supply chains. What Your Impact Is Serve as a trusted authority delivering high‑quality certification and assurance audits against leading sustainability, social, and management system standards. Strengthen client credibility on human rights, labour practices, Indigenous engagement, and grievance mechanisms. Influence better industry outcomes by shaping audit findings into clear, actionable insights for senior decision‑makers. Help evolve ERM CVS’s assurance methodologies, raising the bar across the mining and metals sector worldwide. Required What You’ll Bring A Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in international development, social sciences, law, public policy, anthropology, resource management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in social impact assessment (SIA), FPIC, Indigenous Peoples’ rights, resettlement, or social performance within mining or related sectors. Proven audit experience, including: A minimum of 10 audits, or 3+ years where auditing represents at least 25% of professional responsibilities within the last 5 years. Practical exposure to on‑site mining or minerals operations. Strong working knowledge of social and ESG standards, including: IFC Performance Standards, SA8000, ILO conventions UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights OECD Due Diligence Guidance and related frameworks Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and explain complex findings to technical and non‑technical audiences. Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%. Preferred Lead Auditor qualification for ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, and/or ISO 50001. Hands‑on experience with voluntary mining standards such as IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM Mining Principles, ASI, RMI, or the Consolidated Mining Standard. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17021 accreditation requirements. Multilingual capability, particularly English, Spanish, and Portuguese (additional languages such as French or Bahasa are an asset). Experience mentoring auditors or supporting technical capability development within certification or assurance teams. Key Responsibilities Deliver third‑party certification and assurance audits across international standards, including ISO frameworks, IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM, ASI, and related social and ESG criteria. Evaluate client conformance, performance, and maturity across management systems and social performance requirements. Lead audit planning, execution, and reporting within multi‑disciplinary teams, ensuring methodological rigor and consistency. Prepare clear, high‑quality audit reports that articulate findings, non‑conformities, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Engage directly with client leadership, workforce representatives, communities, and Indigenous stakeholders in line with audit protocols. Manage certification projects end‑to‑end, balancing scope, schedule, quality, and budget. Act as the primary client interface throughout the project lifecycle, building trusted advisory relationships. Contribute to the continuous improvement of ERM CVS methodologies, tools, and technical guidance. Support business development through pre‑audit consultations, proposal inputs, and thought leadership. Mentor and support developing auditors, strengthening capability within the assurance team. About ERM Certification And Verification Services (CVS) ERM CVS is a global leader in certification, assurance, and verification services , partnering with organizations to demonstrate compliance, strengthen ESG performance, and build stakeholder trust. We specialize in ISO certification and sustainability assurance across sectors including Mining, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Technology, and Pharmaceuticals , supporting clients to meet the highest international standards with confidence and credibility. Além disso, contribuirá diretamente para o fortalecimento das metodologias da nossa Unidade de Negócios e para a evolução do setor de mineração e metais em escala global. Qual será o seu impacto? title: Diretor(a) do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico
description: Descrição: 1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA DIRETORA DO HUB DE ENGAJAMENTO ESTRATÉGICO EM MSF-BRASIL? Você irá liderar a equipe multidisciplinar do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, integrando comunicação, gestão de marca, mobilização de recursos e parcerias estratégicas em uma estratégia consistente de engajamento com a sociedade brasileira, suportados por sistemas tecnológicos adequados e análise transversal de dados. Você também será responsável por garantir que as ações do Hub ampliem o conhecimento, a confiança e o engajamento do público brasileiro com a missão médico-humanitária de Médicos Sem Fronteiras e traduzam, de forma impactante e acessível, as realidades vividas pelas populações atendidas, fortalecendo a reputação institucional da organização e promovendo o crescimento sustentável da base de doadores e da receita proveniente de contribuições de indivíduos, empresas e outros parceiros. Além disso, você irá atuar como liderança estratégica responsável por desenvolver uma visão integrada para o Hub, promovendo o alinhamento contínuo entre as equipes multidisciplinares, tomada de decisão baseada em evidências, inovação contínua e foco em impactos mensuráveis, sempre em consonância com os princípios e valores da organização. 2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS? Liderar a transformação organizacional do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico e consolidá-lo como um ecossistema integrado de comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos, dados, tecnologia e parcerias, conduzindo uma jornada gradual de amadurecimento organizacional, fortalecimento de lideranças e ampliação progressiva da autonomia das equipes, bem como fomentando colaboração entre áreas, fortalecendo a cultura de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e impulsionando a adoção de métodos ágeis pelos times do Hub em um ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar; Liderar a visão e a estratégia de posicionamento, engajamento e atração de recursos de MSF-Brasil, zelando pela reputação da Organização e garantindo alinhamento entre as diferentes células do Hub e com outras áreas de MSF-Brasil; Ampliar a base de apoiadores da organização, testando novas abordagens e engajando novas audiências por meio de estratégias inovadoras e ousadas, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade da operação de captação de recursos, e ampliando a contribuição de MSF-Brasil para o projetos médico-humanitários da organização. 3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO? Consolidação e Evolução do Hub Liderar o processo de consolidação do Hub por meio de uma abordagem faseada, equilibrando atuação direta em temas estratégicos e operacionais quando necessário com a construção gradual e progressiva da autonomia e da capacidade decisória das lideranças das células e suas equipes; Desenvolver e implementar a visão estratégica do Hub, alinhada ao Planejamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, monitorando resultados e ajustando prioridades com base em dados e aprendizados; Garantir a integração entre as diferentes células do Hub, promovendo alinhamento estratégico, colaboração e objetivos compartilhados; Liderar a evolução da estrutura, dos processos e dos modelos de trabalho do Hub, fortalecendo a inovação, a transformação organizacional, a cultura orientada por dados e as metodologias ágeis. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas Liderar, desenvolver e apoiar as lideranças das células do Hub, fortalecendo uma cultura de confiança, autonomia, accountability, colaboração e aprendizagem contínua; Promover um ambiente de trabalho ético, inclusivo e seguro, alinhado aos valores e compromissos comportamentais de MSF; Desenvolver capacidades de liderança, impulsionar a adoção de metodologias ágeis e estimular uma cultura de feedback e melhoria contínua. Estratégia de Engajamento, Marca e Mobilização de Recursos Liderar a definição e implementação da estratégia integrada de engajamento institucional de MSF-Brasil, garantindo alinhamento entre comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos e relacionamento com públicos estratégicos; Fortalecer o posicionamento institucional e a reputação de MSF, incluindo a gestão de crises reputacionais e a consistência da comunicação multicanal; Impulsionar estratégias inovadoras para ampliar o engajamento da sociedade, fortalecer a base de apoiadores e promover o crescimento sustentável da receita; Representar a organização junto à mídia, parceiros institucionais, setor humanitário e demais públicos estratégicos. Gestão de Performance, Dados e Tecnologia Garantir que as estratégias e decisões do Hub sejam orientadas por dados, evidências e indicadores de desempenho; Definir e acompanhar indicadores estratégicos, promovendo uma cultura de inovação, aprendizagem contínua e melhoria de resultados; Assegurar a evolução e o uso estratégico de CRM, plataformas de dados, ferramentas digitais e capacidades analíticas voltadas ao engajamento e relacionamento com apoiadores; Liderar a priorização de iniciativas, investimentos e recursos, incluindo a gestão orçamentária do Hub. Representação Institucional e Articulação Global Atuar como principal ponto de articulação do Hub com lideranças regionais e internacionais de MSF, promovendo trocas de conhecimento, alinhamento estratégico e compartilhamento de melhores práticas; Contribuir para fóruns e discussões estratégicas internacionais relacionados a engajamento, comunicação, mobilização de recursos, marca, dados e inovação. Compromissos de Gestão de MSF-Brasil Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores, princípios e compromissos comportamentais da organização, promovendo gestão ética, inclusiva e colaborativa; Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico e o fortalecimento da atuação transversal entre áreas; Promover ativamente práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e respeitoso para todas as pessoas. Requisitos: 4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER? Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em posições de liderança estratégica, com gestão de equipes e condução de projetos e iniciativas organizacionais de alta complexidade; Vivência na definição e implementação de estratégias de comunicação, marketing, marca, engajamento de públicos, relacionamento e/ou mobilização de recursos; Experiência em transformação organizacional, gestão de mudança e fortalecimento de culturas orientadas por dados; Conhecimento e atuação com CRM, plataformas de relacionamento, automação, gestão de dados e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho; Experiência em planejamento estratégico, gestão orçamentária e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Experiência em gestão de reputação institucional e comunicação de crise; Conhecimento em estratégias de marketing, gestão de projetos, metodologias ágeis e negociação; Compreensão de segmentação de públicos, jornadas de engajamento e métricas de aquisição, retenção e conversão; Inglês fluente; Conhecimento do Microsoft 365; Interesse por temas humanitários e pelas realidades que afetam comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade. 5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES? Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing, Estratégia, Inovação ou Gestão de Projetos; Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares; Experiência com MSF e/ou vivência em organizações internacionais, organizações da sociedade civil e/ou contextos de alta complexidade institucional; Experiência em prospecção e desenvolvimento de parcerias institucionais; Proficiência em Espanhol. 6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS? Você precisará ter visão estratégica e pensamento analítico para compreender cenários complexos, conectar diferentes perspectivas e utilizar dados e evidências na definição de estratégias e na tomada de decisões. Será importante demonstrar planejamento e organização para estabelecer prioridades, coordenar diferentes frentes de atuação e garantir o alinhamento das equipes aos objetivos da organização. Além disso, será necessário liderança para mobilizar pessoas em torno de uma visão compartilhada, promover colaboração e engajamento, e iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades, liderar mudanças e desenvolver novas soluções. Por fim, gerenciamento de estresse será essencial para manter equilíbrio, clareza e capacidade de decisão diante de cenários de pressão, mudanças e múltiplas demandas. PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA: MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD. PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 13/09/2026 RETORNO: Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Utility Operator
description: The Utility Operator operates and maintains engine room and utility systems to ensure operational continuity and energy efficiency. The role performs routine equipment inspections, logbook recordkeeping, and basic maintenance tasks under supervisor guidance. Additionally, it enforces strict compliance with company HSE policies, Permit-to-Work procedures, and safety standards. Responsibilities Operate and monitor utility systems, including power generation (turbines/generators), compressed air systems, potable and industrial water systems, boilers and steam systems, HVAC systems, and effluent and sewage treatment Perform routine inspections, basic maintenance, and operational parameter readings on utility systems and machinery, checking for leaks, abnormal noise, vibration, and general equipment condition Actively participate in Engine Room maintenance tasks, including disassembly, inspection, cleaning, and reassembly of equipment (pumps, valves, filters, heat exchangers), routine lubrication, tightening, alignment checks, and minor repairs on rotating machinery Maintain the Engine Room Logbook updated and accurate, recording operational parameters, deviations, and events in the management system Monitor oil and fuel consumption, targeting efficiency and maximum equipment availability. Execute operational adjustments per supervisor procedures and recommendations Perform system maneuvers and valve operations for operational and maintenance purposes. Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities as applicable Identify anomalies, unsafe or potentially critical conditions, promptly communicating them to leadership and QHSE. Ensure compliance with HSE standards and procedures Assist in commissioning and testing of utility equipment. Interact with Operations, Maintenance, and Safety teams to resolve operational issues Maintain high housekeeping standards in the engine room and utility areas. Ensure adherence to safe operational practices and protection of equipment integrity Strictly comply with HSE procedures, including PPE, EPC, PTW (Permit to Work), SIMOPS, and Job Safety Analysis (JSA). Ensure safe equipment preparation before maintenance activities, including isolation, drainage, depressurization, ventilation, and line cleaning Assist in reinstallation and commissioning of systems after maintenance completion. Participate in training, emergency drills, and maintain valid certifications Ensure personal safety and the safety of fellow workers, operating under the Zero Incidents standard Requirements Education Technical qualification Experience Knowledge of mechanical, electromechanical, automation, and chemical processes and systems Previous experience in utility operations, preferably in offshore or heavy industrial environments Experience with engines, pumps, compressors, boilers, and water/energy systems Knowledge of power generation and distribution systems, boilers and water treatment, rotating equipment, P&IDs, and safety procedures #J-18808-Ljbffr

Atualizar o Gerente de Serviços / Coordenador / Supervisor / Tracker sobre o trabalho que está sendo executado, visando atualizar as informações necessárias para a continuação das atividades; - Aplicar conhecimentos em sistemas hidráulicos, pneumáticos e mecânicos para os colaboradores que atuam na área de Mecânica e eletro-eletrônicos, automação e controle para os colaboradores que atuam na área de Elétrica/Eletrônica, a fim de solucionar falhas em equipamentos NOV onshore e offshore; - Trabalhar com resolução de problemas, reparos e calibração dos equipamentos de serviços de campos petrolíferos junto aos clientes, garantindo um funcionamento satisfatório; - Realizar instalações, inspeções, reparos e comissionamento no Brasil e Exterior; - Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe de Serviços e Clientes, quando necessário; - Fazer interface do cliente com a NOV para possíveis transações comerciais; - Elaborar documentação técnica, conforme normas e procedimentos; - Coordenar atividades de trabalho na área; - Desmontar / montar equipamentos com base em desenhos técnicos, assegurando o conhecimento do modo de montagem e a certificação de que os mesmos estão dentro dos padrões NOV; - Verificar os desgastes nas áreas críticas dos equipamentos por meio dos instrumentos de medição, observando substituição ou ausência de substituição de peças, bem como possíveis reparos (internos / externos); - Pesquisar e introduzir novas formas de execução dos trabalhos de manutenção, visando aprimorar a qualidade dos serviços prestados; - Realizar inspeção visual nos equipamentos, notificando em relatório o estado de conservação e de funcionamento dos equipamentos, visando identificar necessidades de reparos; - Identificar e analisar situação problema, pesquisando tecnicamente uma alternativa para sua solução, assegurando o funcionamento adequado e uma maior vida útil do equipamento; - Identificar e listar as peças necessárias para a manutenção, assegurando que a requisição irá gerar a adequada manutenção e reparo; - Executar as tarefas a serem realizadas através do conhecimento do plano de ação para a finalização do serviço, com base na qualidade e prazo; - Auxiliar a Supervisão / Gerência em atividades administrativas quando necessário; Qualificações: Ensino Técnico completo e/ou Engenharia em Eletrônica, Elétrica, Eletroeletrônico, desejável ênfase em Automação/Controle; Experiência prévia na função ou similares; Requerido inglês avançado - Será testado; Experiência em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos/esquemáticos; Utilização de instrumentos de medição (multímetro, testador de isolação, alicate de miliamperímetro, etc.); Conhecimento técnico em redes de fibra ótica; Desejável experiência em equipamentos de perfuração como Top Drive, Drawworks, Iron Roughneck, etc, e sistema de controles como PLC Siemens Step 7; Conhecimentos em linguagem de programação Step7 (Blocks, Ladder e STL), Java e C++ serão diferenciais; Disponibilidade para viajar e realizar atividades em plataformas offshore/onshore. Locations Rua Piloto Rommel Oliveira Garcia, Macae, Rio de Janeiro, , BR #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor de vendas
description: Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Vendas para atuar no canal Cash & Carry (Atacarejo) , liderando a execução da estratégia comercial da Forno de Minas em sua região de atuação. Esta posição será responsável por desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes, liderar equipes de vendas, garantir a excelência da execução no ponto de venda e impulsionar resultados sustentáveis para o negócio. O que você fará. Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de vendas sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo alta performance e engajamento. Assegurar o cumprimento das metas de volume, faturamento, rentabilidade e participação de mercado. Gerenciar o relacionamento e as negociações com clientes estratégicos do canal Cash & Carry (Atacarejo). Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e propor planos de ação para maximizar resultados. Garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais e de trade marketing nos pontos de venda. Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, expansão de portfólio e aumento da distribuição. Realizar visitas regulares aos clientes e acompanhar a atuação da equipe em campo. Analisar informações de mercado, concorrência e tendências de consumo para geração de oportunidades. Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Trade Marketing, Customer Service, Logística e Finanças para assegurar a melhor experiência aos clientes. Contribuir para o fortalecimento das marcas e para o crescimento sustentável da Forno de Minas. O que você precisa para ter sucesso. Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida na área comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo. Experiência comprovada no canal Cash & Carry (Atacarejo). Vivência anterior em liderança e gestão de equipes de vendas externas. Conhecimento em negociação comercial e gestão de clientes estratégicos. Domínio de indicadores de vendas e ferramentas de análise de desempenho. Conhecimento do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint. Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes. Perfil analítico, comunicativo, resiliente e orientado para resultados. Você fará parte da equipe Comercial da Forno de Minas, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e focado em resultados. A posição possui interface constante com diversas áreas da companhia e desempenha papel fundamental na execução da estratégia comercial e no fortalecimento da presença da marca junto aos principais clientes do canal Atacarejo. Há mais de 30 anos, a Forno de Minas leva sabor e tradição para a mesa dos brasileiros. Reconhecida pela qualidade de seus produtos e pela inovação constante, a empresa combina a autenticidade das receitas mineiras com uma forte atuação no mercado nacional e internacional. Trabalhar na Forno de Minas é fazer parte de uma história construída com paixão, proximidade e excelência. Valorizamos lideranças que inspiram, desenvolvem pessoas e promovem um ambiente colaborativo. Buscamos profissionais que atuem com protagonismo, senso de dono, foco em resultados e compromisso com a construção de relações de confiança com clientes, parceiros e equipes. Transformação digital e inovação. A Forno de Minas acredita na inovação como um dos pilares para o crescimento sustentável. Incentivamos o uso de ferramentas digitais, análise de dados e novas tecnologias para apoiar a tomada de decisão, aumentar a eficiência e gerar melhores resultados para o negócio. A experiência Forno de Minas. Aqui, valorizamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e que desejam construir sua carreira em uma empresa que cresce sem abrir mão de seus valores. Oferecemos um ambiente acolhedor, desafiador e repleto de oportunidades de desenvolvimento, onde cada colaborador contribui para levar o melhor da Forno de Minas aos nossos consumidores todos os dias. #J-18808-Ljbffr
